The adjacent WAV is a synthetic output comparison fixture.

It was produced with the original C++ WavWriter from upstream commit
a7fdb4e822bde95e462827cccca55fb008c0c5ae, compiled with MSVC.
The writer received 48 kHz, two-channel, 16-bit PCM. The input samples were
0, 0, 8192, -8192, 32767, -32767, -8192, 8192, 16384, -16384, 0, 0.
The writer received the first four samples and the remaining eight samples
in separate calls. The Rust test parses each container's data chunk and
compares the PCM bytes. The original fmt chunk has 18 bytes. The Rust fmt
chunk has 16 bytes. Both identify PCM with the same rate and channel count.
